shared_elements: incised linear detailing on a monolithic block
justification: Both are monolithic stone monuments bearing shallow relief that includes round disc-like bosses and what reads as a frontal human figure with an ornate headdress element at the top, and in both the carving follows a gently convex block surface. The differences dominate: A is a fine-grained pale stone crowded with small, densely packed rectangular glyph-like blocks and intricate curvilinear detail seen in close-up, while B is a coarse dark stone whose few, large, boldly simplified motifs are spaced across the whole visible body of a freestanding figure.
